question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who loves mankind
solution:
The correct answer is: **Philanthropist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Philanthropist **is a noun that refers to a person who loves mankind and seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money to good causes. (लोकोपकारक)
 
• The word comes from the Greek roots phil- (love) and anthropos (man).
